{{Quote|So you're part of the Mining Guild, then?"<br />"No, not actually. Our operation is small enough not to be noticed, which is advantageous for everybody since our customers are anxious to avoid attracting attention to themselves.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], concerning [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''Mining Guild''' was one of the many [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporate entities that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It survived the fall of the commerce guilds during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and continued into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I'm not interested in the petty squabbles of your Mining Guild. Lord Vader wants results!|[[Namman Cha]]|<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Dealing with the Guild}}</ref>}}
The Mining Guild was originally founded in the early days of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] exploration, [[Pre-Republic era|predating]] even the [[Unification Wars (Galactic Republic)|formation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The Guild was established in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and though a specific [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] did not come to light [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] was one of their strongholds, because of its abundance of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so valuable in the early space travel.<ref name="TEA" /> Eventually the Guild was based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the rule of the Galactic Republic, though they maintained a regional headquarters on Empress Teta, where they ruled by proxy through the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="NoP" /> The Mining Guild grew into one of the many quasi-[[Politics/Legends|political]] corporate entities represented in the Republic, alongside the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. They often were engaged in confrontations with rival company [[Exargan Mining Authority]] that were settled through the courts.<ref name="HNN52:MGTFE">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|business/13418_2.html|Mining Guild to Fine Exarga}}</ref>

[[File:MiningGuildRecruiter-PGT.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mining Guild Recruiter]]
The Guild dominated operations on billions of young, metal-rich [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] scattered throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] spiral arms and mined resources there extensively. It was on one of these anonymous planets that [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] gained her [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|''Koro-2'' exodrive airspeeder]], subsequently using it far from the wastelands of these worlds, where there was a lack of complex lifeforms that could be hurt by the more noxious gases produced by the [[Miner/Legends|miners]]' vehicles.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> As of [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the Guild had holdings on [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]], where they were represented by [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]] [[Gilfrome]].<ref name="OF" />

The Mining Guild was fortunate enough to survive the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and expanded with the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ensured the officials of the Mining Guild allied themselves with his Empire, to solidify his sources of raw materials for the Imperial war machine while still keeping the Guild itself independent. On Empress Teta, though much the mining operations had ended due to dry mines, the Mining Guild maintained its power through Emperor [[Alor Keto/Legends|Alor Keto]]. Additionally, most [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] on the planet had a share of the Guild's work in the system and were kept receptive to the interests of the Guild.<ref name="NoP" /> The Imperial regime seemed to have adverse effects on the Mining Guild, since, during the Civil War, it did not appear to enforce its policies quite as well as it should&mdash;small operations such as [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] remained unnoticed by the Guild.<ref name="ESB" />

Thanks to its independence from the Empire, the Mining Guild remained in operation when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] supplanted Palpatine's regime, and operated as a trade union regulating the supply of ore to both sides of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Guild rose to a new level of power under the Republic, and began to command high prices for the ores its members delivered, in some cases negotiating local truces between Imperial and Republic forces. During this time, many of its members engaged in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and other [[Black market/Legends|black market]] activities for the benefit of both themselves individually and the Guild.
